narrative.intro: Nelnet Servicing obligated $294M in FY2026 to date. Nelnet Servicing won 8 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $36.8M. Nelnet Servicing obligations are down 25.9% year over year. Nelnet Servicing annual obligations have moved from $145M in FY21 to $240M in FY22, then to $351M in FY23, $407M in FY24, $397M in FY25, and $294M in FY26. Nelnet Servicing current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Nelnet Servicing figures here are contract obligations except for award-value line items, which are total contract values. Nelnet Servicing award count and average award size reflect only awards counted in the current fiscal year. Nelnet Servicing year-over-year change measures the comparison of the current fiscal year to the prior fiscal year on obligations. Nelnet Servicing readers should treat FY2026 totals as incomplete for the full fiscal year.
